name: Reminiscence
desc:
The delicate power distilled from time itself. It's all the seemingly insignificant moments that weave together a magnificent destiny. 
"In the fleeting sweet dream, it was as if the old soul had returned to the colorful waters of childhood."

ability.name: Going to Sleep
ability.desc: When memosprite's turn starts, the wearer and memosprite each gain 1 stack of "Commemoration." Each stack increases DMG dealt by {0}%, stacking up to 4 time(s). When memosprite disappears, removes "Commemoration" from the wearer and memosprite.
